spin.reason: manual QA by Claude (QA agent): Four tumble frames compared at native packed scale (bodyHeight 174) with gojo-combat_v01/neutral_v01 and the tucked backDash f1/jumpSquat: crown-to-chin 39 px vs combat 38 / neutral 39-40, side-view shoe 36-38 px vs combat 38, shins and hands consistent.
